purpose: Rank likely next machine states and user follow-up inputs, prepare high-value branches early, execute safe dependency-satisfied next actions without waiting for another prompt, and calibrate both prediction and execution quality from what actually happens.
current_program: Aurum Tiny Seed / recovery foundation with parallel experiments and Future Branch calibration

examples: you predicted that, but did you actually do it?
you listed the next thing but didn't do it
what did you prepare instead of just predicting?
likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Compare prediction and preparation/execution separately. A correct prediction with omitted safe work is an execution miss and earns zero useful-hit credit.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Immediately perform the safe implied work, record prediction debt, update calibration, and re-rank this branch family upward until execution catches prediction.

examples: was that one of your branches?
so what did you already do?
likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Compare the actual input against the prior ranked branch field, report exact/partial/miss without inflating the score, and also report execution/preparation completeness.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Persist calibration, re-rank the branch field, and execute any newly obvious safe follow-up immediately.

likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Read live build/evidence state and include passed/running/failed/published plus whether human action is needed.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Advance any newly unblocked repo/CI step before reporting.

examples: is the ISO the wrong way to do this?
should we use a different carrier?
are we wasting time fixing this boot path?
likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Compare the current ISO-hybrid path against alternate carriers using repeated-failure cost, verification friction, platform coverage, recovery simplicity, reuse value, and time-to-physical-proof. Treat the carrier as replaceable while preserving the same germ/genetics/LKG contract.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Keep the current path alive while preparing the strongest alternative. Promote the alternative only when evidence shows lower total expected cost or the current carrier repeatedly fails the same class of gate.

examples: how do we know this works?
likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Report prediction accuracy, execution completeness, useful-hit rate, prepared-action hit rate, user turns avoided, wait-time saved, discarded speculative cost, and self-corrections found before the user encountered them.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Update calibration/evidence metrics and compare them against a reactive baseline.

likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Map terse report to boot/media/network/install/regrow/rollback branch using embedded triage and boot proof.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Use captured evidence, apply smallest safe fix, rebuild/rerun, preserve LKG.

likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Immediately advance to the next gated proof rather than asking what the user wants to do next.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Verify boot receipt, Guardian/LKG state, then continue healthy regrow/promotion or next physical gate.

likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Do the highest-value already-authorized next operation first; answer with what was advanced and the next real boundary.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Advance completion graph and adjacent independent lanes.

examples: what can run at the same time?
likely_user_inputs.prepared_response: Fan out independent lanes and prepare downstream dependent carts without crossing real boundaries.
likely_user_inputs.action_if_safe: Continue experiments, recovery prep, integrity, status, and next-capability work in parallel.

likely_machine_outcomes.next: physical flash/readback and real boot proof
diagnose exact failing gate, safe patch, rerun without weakening verification

prepared: current ISO path retained as control
likely_machine_outcomes.next: prepare and benchmark a universal disk-image/front-door carrier in parallel, then pivot only if it reaches physical-proof readiness with lower expected total cost
repair network/setup while preserving germ and LKG
treat rollback as protection success, repair candidate, regrow only inactive slot
advance experimental canaries without confusing them with production proof

calibration.rule: A useful hit requires both prediction and preparation/execution. A broader neighboring family does not count as exact. A missing high-value branch becomes prediction debt and changes future ranking.

real_boundaries: physical boot/reboot interaction when no remote path exists
irreversible or materially risky hardware/system changes
